# Search1API

Search1API provides web, maps, and news search alongside crawling, screenshots, sitemap discovery, and structured data extraction for AI agents.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/search1api/.

## Actions

- **Ask Research** (read-only): Run a natural-language research query across up to five provider-selected engines and return at most 10 deduplicated, reranked results…
- **Crawl URLs** (read-only): Fetch readable content from one or more public URLs.
- **Discover Sitemap** (read-only): Discover sitemap URLs for a public site, or list all links on one public page without fetching page content.
- **Extract Structured Data** (read-only): Extract caller-defined structured data from one public webpage using an optional prompt and JSON response shape.
- **Get Deepcrawl Status** (read-only): Get the current state of a deepcrawl task and its packaged result URL when available.
- **Get Health** (read-only): Read Search1API's free, unauthenticated provider serving/readiness status.
- **Get Trending** (read-only): Return a platform's current live trending feed.
- **Get Usage** (read-only): Return the connected account's remaining Search1API credits and credential metadata.
- **Search Maps** (read-only): Search one Google Maps results page for businesses or places.
- **Search News** (read-only): Search recent news for one or more queries with source, site, language, and time filters, returning a typed outcome for each.
- **Search Web** (read-only): Search the web for one or more queries and return a typed outcome for each.
- **Start Deepcrawl**: Start an asynchronous multi-page crawl of a public site and return its task ID.
- **Submit Feedback**: Create external feedback for Search1API about a problem, missing capability, or confusing documentation encountered during a task.
- **Take Screenshot** (read-only): Render a public webpage as a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file with viewport, readiness, selector, and appearance controls.
